stories.name: Marcus
stories.summary: After 8 years incarcerated, Marcus entered the Renewal phase with a mentor. Within 90 days he secured stable housing and a warehouse job. Today he mentors others in the program.

stories.name: James
stories.summary: Battling addiction for over a decade, James worked through the Crossroads curriculum. With accountability and faith community, he reached one year of sobriety and reconnected with his children.

stories.name: Andre
stories.summary: A justice-involved young man, Andre was paired with a relational mentor and marketplace coach. He finished his GED and started an apprenticeship through a partner employer.
